summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated math_init.js payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime archive from GitHub releases into a temp directory, extracts it, chmods the binary +x, and uses it to execute a 727KB obfuscated sibling bundle `math_init.js` (Bun-compiled, `// @bun @bun-cjs`, shuffled-string-array decoder). The `setup.mjs` script itself is obfuscator.io-style hex-renamed (`_0x488df8`, string-alias tables), which is unusual for a benign bootstrap script. The package advertises itself as a static repo-config for React and has no documented need for a second language runtime or a large opaque bundle. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern — pulling in Bun specifically to run bundled code outside Node's visibility — plus preinstall-time execution of an obfuscated payload gives the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
